title: Spacecraft Dynamics
text: Model dynamics of one or more spacecraft, 21 inputs, 11 outputs, {Ephemeris model} sets Ephemeris model; {Input body forces} sets the option to enable external forces, {Input body moments} sets the option to enable external moments, {Input external accelerations} sets the option to input additional force, {External acceleration coordinate frame} sets the frame for acceleration input, {State vector output coordinate frame} sets the position and velocity state output port coordinate frame, {Output total inertial acceleration} sets the option to enable total acceleration port, {Start date/time (UTC Julian date)} sets the initial start time for simulation, {Output current date/time (UTC Julian date)} sets the option to add output port t utc, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior, {Mass type} sets the spacecraft mass type, {Mass} sets the initial mass of rigid body spacecraft, {Empty mass} sets the spacecraft empty mass, {Full mass} sets the spacecraft full mass, {Inertia tensor}, {Empty inertia tensor}, {Full inertia tensor}, {Include mass flow relative velocity} sets the option to enable mass flow velocity, {Limit mass flow when mass is empty or full} sets the option to limit mass flow, {Output fuel tank status} sets the option to enable fuel tank status, {Initial state format} sets the input method for initial states of orbit Orbital, {Orbit type} sets the orbit classification, {Semi-major axis} sets the half of major axis of ellipse, {Eccentricity} sets the deviation of orbit, {Inclination} sets the tilt angle of orbital plane, {RAAN} sets the angular distance in equatorial plane, {Argument of periapsis} sets the angle from spacecraft ascending node, {True anomaly} sets the angle between periapsis and initial position, {Argument of latitude} sets the angle between ascending node and initial position, {Longitude of periapsis} sets the angle between ICRF x -axis and eccentricity, {True longitude} sets the angle between ICRF x -axis and initial position, {ICRF position} sets the cartesian position vector of spacecraft, {ICRF velocity} sets the cartesian velocity vector of spacecraft, {Fixed-frame position} sets the position vector of spacecraft, {Fixed-frame velocity} sets the velocity vector of spacecraft, {Attitude reference coordinate frame} sets the attitude and angular rate coordinate frame, {Attitude representation} sets the orientation format, {Initial body attitude} sets the spacecraft initial attitude, {Angle rotation order}, {Initial body angular rates PQR} sets the initial body-fixed angular rates, {Output total inertial angular acceleration} sets the option to enable total vehicle, {Include gravity gradient torque} sets the option to enable gravity gradient torque, {Central body} sets the celestial body around which spacecraft orbits, {Gravitational potential model} sets the gravity model for central body Spherical harmonics when Central body set to Earth, Moon, Mars, or Custom, Oblate ellipsoid when Central body set to Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, {Spherical harmonic model}, {Rotational rate}, {Spherical harmonic coefficient file} sets the harmonic coefficient MAT file, {Degree}, {Use Earth orientation parameters (EOPs)} sets the option to use Earth orientation parameters, {IERS EOP data file} sets the earth orientation data, {Input Moon libration angles} sets the moon libration Euler angle rate, {Output quaternion (ICRF to Fixed-frame)} sets the option to add output transformation quaternion, {Central body spin axis source} sets the central body spin, {Spin axis right ascension (RA) at J2000} sets the right ascension of central body spin axis, {Spin axis RA rate (deg/century)} sets the right ascension rate of central body spin, {Spin axis declination (Dec) at J2000} sets the declination of central body spin axis, {Spin axis Dec rate (deg/century)} sets the declination rate of central body spin axis, {Initial rotation angle at J2000} sets the rotation angle of central body x -axis, {Rotation rate (deg/day)} sets the rotation rate of central body x -axis, {Equatorial radius}, {Flattening}, {Gravitational parameter}, {Second degree zonal harmonic (J2)} sets the most significant or largest spherical harmonic term, {Include atmospheric drag} sets the option to include atmospheric drag, {Atmospheric density source} sets the source of atmospheric density, {Atmospheric model}, {Flux source} sets the source of space weather, {Space weather data file} sets the mAT file of space weather data, {F10.7 extrapolation method} sets the extrapolation method for f107Average and f107Daily None, {Magnetic index extrapolation method} sets the extrapolation method for magnetic index information None, {Flags source} sets the variation flag source, {Flags} sets the variation flags ones, {Include anomalous oxygen in density calculation} sets the option to include anomalous oxygen in density, {Drag coefficient source} sets the source of drag, {Drag coefficient} sets the spacecraft coefficient of drag, {Drag area source} sets the source of drag, {Drag area} sets the area to compute acceleration due to atmospheric, {Limit ephemerides date range} sets the option to enable start and end of range of ephemeris, {Start date (JD)} sets the start date of ephemerides date range, {End date (JD)} sets the end date of ephemerides date range, {Include third body gravity} sets the acceleration due to third body gravity, {Sun} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Sun gravity model} sets the third body gravity model for Sun, {Mercury} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Mercury gravity model}, {Venus} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Venus gravity model}, {Earth} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Earth gravity model}, {Moon} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Moon gravity model}, {Mars} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Mars gravity model}, {Jupiter} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Jupiter gravity model}, {Saturn} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Saturn gravity model}, {Uranus} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Uranus gravity model}, {Neptune} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Neptune gravity model}, {Pluto} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Pluto gravity model}, {Custom} sets the include gravitational acceleration due to custom, {Custom gravity model}, {Gravitational parameter (m^3/s^2)} sets the custom gravitational acceleration, {Include solar radiation pressure (SRP)} sets the acceleration due to solar radiation, {Eclipse fraction source} sets the source of eclipse, {Shadow model}, {Include Earth} sets the option to include Earth, {Include Moon} sets the option to include Moon, {Reflectivity coefficient source} sets the source for spacecraft coefficient, {Reflectivity coefficient} sets the spacecraft coefficient of reflectivity, {SRP area source} sets the source for spacecraft solar radiation pressure area, {SRP area} sets the cross section area of the spacecraft seen, {Solar flux pressure (W*s/m^3)} sets the spacecraft solar flux pressure, {Units} sets the parameter and port units Metric, {Angle units} and {Time format}. Values come from the instance.
